svg.title: CI/CD Architecture Diagram
svg.desc: End-to-end CI/CD pipeline: GitHub to GitHub Actions to Docker Hub to Ansible Tower to Kubernetes

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the developer do in the CI/CD pipeline?')
sendPrompt('What is GitHubs role in the CI/CD pipeline?')
sendPrompt('What jobs run in GitHub Actions?')
sendPrompt('What is Docker Hub used for in this pipeline?')
sendPrompt('How is Ansible Tower configured in this pipeline?')
sendPrompt('What does the Ansible deploy playbook do?')
sendPrompt('How is Kubernetes configured in this setup?')
sendPrompt('What GitHub secrets are needed for this pipeline?')
